title: wg: protocol-06 §7.6 redefines Uri and UTF8String
description: Erratum/editorial. §7.6 defines struct Uri { opaque uri<V>; } duplicating §5.2 IdentifierUri, and repeats the UTF8String definition from earlier sections. mimid treats Uri as IdentifierUri (decision mimid-1wgh.5.44). Fix: reuse IdentifierUri and reference the single UTF8String definition.
